elements_selected.content: Create src/web/templates/base.html by extracting the master layout from html.rs::layout(). This template defines the DOCTYPE, <head> with DaisyUI/Tailwind CDN links, all inline CSS, the drawer layout, sidebar, search modal, and inline JS. Define blocks: {% block head %}, {% block styles %}, {% block sidebar %}, {% block content %}, {% block scripts %}. Use Minijinja syntax. Template variables: vault.name, vault.pages (for sidebar), search_index, zetl.version, theme. The sidebar navigation must match the current sidebar_html() output exactly — same nested <ul> structure, same slug links, same collision-aware display names.
